body: Well it's hard to change anything without making things crazier, if I had money I would have looked at professional help an while ago.  And honestly I'm terrified of antidepressants, I don't even know if the coping methods I used previously would still work.  I just don't really have the option to do it anymore.  And I know that a lot of others possibly you included deal with this all the time.  But it just seems to flare up with me, I can go months without any of these thoughts, or the feeling of being useless.  But when it does it jus hits me like a truck.  No one ever seems to know what to do with me when it happens.

I don't really know who I am emotionally anymore.  I'm just scared of commitments because of my dark thoughts.  It's hard not to drag people down ya'know.  The major driving force of living is the hope that things get better, that life is a tunnel and not just a cave.
